newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Gov says LIPA head to step down on April 18.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Gov says LIPA head to step down on April 18.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki on Wednesday said Frank Zarb, who leads the Long Island Power Authority (LIPA), will step down April 18 to become the chairman and chief executive officer of the National Association of Securities Dealers.
Mike McKeon, a spokesman for Pataki, said a new chairman for LIPA should be selected shortly. "That hasn't been decided yet," he said.
Asked when a decision might be made, he replied, "I would say in the near future."

Pataki saluted Zarb's work in helping to get a pact for the Authority to buy assets from the Long Island Lighting Co and Brooklyn Union Gas that he said would cut electricity rates, protect taxpayers from property tax hikes and settle tax litigation over the failed Shoreham nuclear plant.
